confirm.transactional: It runs in a single transaction (all-or-nothing).
confirm.oneByOne: Statements apply one by one; a failure can be fixed and resumed.

title: Schema Sync

pick.heading: Sync a database schema
pick.intro: The **source** defines the desired schema; the **target** is changed to match it. Both must be connected and use the same database type.
pick.needTwo: Connect at least two databases of the same type to sync.

inSyncBody: The target already matches the source. No changes needed.

chip.dropTitle: Deletes objects that exist only on the target. Hide it to sync additively, never removing anything.
chip.noKeys: No key, index or foreign-key changes in this diff.
chip.keysTitle: Keys, indexes and foreign keys can fail to apply when the target has duplicate or orphaned rows (a data issue, not a schema one). Hide them to sync the rest, then add them once the data is clean.

additive: Additive sync: nothing will be removed from the target.
cardTitle: Click to include or exclude, shift-click to select a range
sentTo: Sent to {assistant}. Read its fix in the chat, paste the corrected statement above, then Retry.
stoppedBody: The migration stopped before a single statement could be pinpointed. Go back to the changes, or recompute the diff against the live database.
resyncTitle: Re-introspect the target and rebuild the diff (use after fixing the cause, e.g. clearing duplicate rows).

appliedBody.one: Applied {count} statement to {target}. The databases are in sync.
appliedBody.other: Applied {count} statements to {target}. The databases are in sync.
